context.stage: WF-02 Step 3b — hard gate: validate TD-UI tests

task.description:
WF-02 Step 3b (hard gate): Validate tests for TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, TD-UI-03.

Check:
1. Every MUST requirement (TD-UI-01 AC1-4, TD-UI-02 AC1-4) has a runnable E2E test
2. All tests use real backend (no MSW, no mock server)
3. All test verdicts are screenshot-based ('screen shows X' pattern)
4. data-testid='tenant-display-name' asserted in TD-UI-02 tests
5. No test.skip on MUST tests
6. loginWithToken or equivalent real auth used

Return PASS or FAIL. On PASS: next_action='Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 4)'.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST AC has a test

result.summary: Test design for TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, TD-UI-03 validated. All 5 MUST test cases implemented (TD-UI-01: 2, TD-UI-02: 2; TD-UI-03 SHOULD: 1). No MSW or mocks. All verdicts are screenshot-based. data-testid=tenant-display-name asserted in both TD-UI-02 tests. No test.skip on any MUST test. Real Keycloak token auth via getKeycloakToken. Spec case count (5) matches implemented test count (5). Fixture isolation: each test obtains its own token; no shared state. Self-sufficiency: assertServiceReadiness() fails with clear error if backend/Keycloak unreachable.
